prompt: launch video for a note-taking app

plan.title: Meet the note app that finds your ideas for you
plan.description: A launch video for a new note-taking app that keeps ideas easy to capture and easy to find. See how capture, organize and search work in three simple steps.

beats.narration: You had a great idea this morning. Where is it now? Maybe on a sticky note, in a text to yourself, or in a notebook buried in your bag.

props.alt: cluttered desk with notebooks and papers

beats.narration: Ideas do not vanish because they are bad. They vanish because they are scattered. Every lost note costs you time, focus, and sometimes the best thought of your week.
So we built one calm place for everything you think. A note-taking app that catches your ideas fast, keeps them tidy, and brings them back the moment you need them.

props.text: One calm place for everything you think.

beats.narration: It works in three simple steps. First, capture. Second, organize. Third, find. Each step is built to take seconds, so your notes never slow you down.
Capture is instant. Open the app, start typing, and your note is saved. Jot a quick line on your phone while walking, or write long pages at your desk.
Organize without the chore. Group notes into folders, add simple tags, or just let them sit in order. Your notes stay neat, and you never have to think about filing.
Finding is where it shines. Type a word or a few letters, and the right note appears. No digging through pages, no scrolling forever. Your idea is back in seconds.

props.heading: Search that just works
items: Pick up where you left off

beats.narration: Your notes also go where you go. Write on your phone, then continue on your laptop. Everything stays in sync, so the latest version is always the one in front of you.

clip_queries: person working on tablet at home
props.alt: person switching between phone and laptop

beats.narration: Think of the people who need this. Students gathering lessons, writers chasing a sentence, teams planning a project, anyone with a head full of thoughts and no place to put them.
A good note-taking app should disappear. It should feel like thinking out loud, then quietly remember everything for you. That is the promise we built this around.

props.clip_query: person writing in notebook by window
clip_queries: person writing in notebook by window

beats.narration: So stop chasing lost ideas. Capture them, keep them, find them. Start your first note today, and let your best thoughts finally stay put.

props.title: Capture it. Keep it. Find it.
props.subtitle: Your ideas, finally in one place
